name: studio-kit
description: Studio Kit: production guardrails and QA skills for building premium websites with Claude Code.

plugins.name: studio-kit
plugins.description: Free core: launch-qa (render the real page and check it at 3 widths), five-attacks (pre-launch security test), concrete-copy (copy rules + HTML linter), and two hooks: deploy-gate (asks a human before recognized production deploys) and secret-guard (blocks common API key formats in source, in VITE_/NEXT_PUBLIC_ vars and in git add of a non-ignored .env).
